units:
T1 driver, stage `evaluate`: the pre-registered T1 comparison (DESIGN §1 "no loss", §6.3, §6.0 A1.6/A1.9).

UNITS (identical for every method; every method's output is mapped onto the replicate DB's sequences):
  peptidoform  (I/L-collapsed sequence, Met-ox position set).  The method's own peptide-level q (Sage peptide_q; mokapot
               peptide q-value; Vulcan paired double competition, peptidoform units, hash tie-break 11).
  sequence     I/L-collapsed stripped sequence; q = min over its peptidoforms, score = max (same rule for all).
  protein      picked protein groups (vulcan.stats.protein.picked_group_fdr, subset grouping, rescue, seed 11) over the
               method's sequence-level best scores, proteins from the SAME FASTA mapping for every method; target
               groups at picked q <= alpha.  (Our estimator for every method: Sage's own protein_q is not used.)
  A unit is "identified in run r" if it is accepted (dataset-level q) and has >= 1 top-1 PSM in run r.

screened_armC.definition:
D18 secondary arm C, REPORTED ONLY (never changes a verdict).  Foreign (arm-C) peptides are
                excluded if (i) LADDER: they share a >= 4-ion terminal b or y ladder with any TARGET peptide of the
                search database whose precursor lies in the window -- implemented as an identical I/L-collapsed
                4-residue N-terminal prefix (b1-b4) or C-terminal suffix (y1-y4), with |M_E - M_T - k*1.003355| <=
                10 ppm for k in {-1, 0, 1} on unmodified + Met-ox (0..3) neutral masses (CAM); "any target" rather than
                "any human target" (on T1, HYE, this is stricter: yeast and E. coli targets screen too); or (ii) TAXON:
                they are a tryptic peptide (scripts/entrapment/peptides.digest, I/L-collapsed) of a foreign protein
                whose FASTA header matches the fixed plastid / photosynthesis / food-allergen list TAXON_PATTERNS
                below (3g remedy 1; written before any T1 output).  Arm C is then recomputed on the 5 arm-C
                replicates (combined estimator, r recomputed on the screened foreign set), at alpha in {0.1, 1, 5}%,
                peptidoform and sequence, conventions (a) and (b).
                {"n_excluded": int, "n_excluded_ladder": int, "n_excluded_taxon": int, "n_foreign": int,
                 "definition": str, "methods": {method: {level: {alpha: {"a": {...}, "b": {...}}}}}}
